name: Summon: Knights of Round
oracle_text:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after V.)
I, II, III, IV — Create three 2/2 white Knight creature tokens.
V — Ultimate End — Other creatures you control get +2/+2 until end of turn. Put an indestructible counter on each of them.
Indestructible
blocked_sentences: I, II, III, IV — Create three 2/2 white Knight creature tokens.

needs.what: a vanilla 2/2 white Knight creature token in the token pool (data/cards/tokens.cards.json), id in the style of the existing entries — `knight_2_2_w` — with types ["Creature"], subtypes ["Knight"], power 2, toughness 2, colors ["W"] and no keywords, so `create_token` has an id to name for this chapter
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `create_token` can only name a token already defined in data/cards/tokens.cards.json, and the pool has no plain 2/2 white Knight. The two nearest entries are both wrong: `knight_2_2_w_vigilance` is the right size, color and subtype but carries vigilance, which this card does not print — twelve tokens across the four chapters would each gain an evasion-relevant ability the card never grants; and `human_knight_2_2_r_trample_haste` is red, adds the Human subtype, and has trample and haste. The other 2/2 white tokens (`ox_2_2_w`, `cat_beast_2_2_w`) have the wrong subtype, which is load-bearing on a Knight-tribal card.
